note: The known limit (chapter 15.4 B-100, owner item): the bursty relay of syn-bursty-cycle-150 with the source clock fast by 100 ppm, so a lock that read the clock would read -100. On a diffuse scatter the densest band is a horizontal slice of a cloud wider than itself and reads about zero whatever the clock: locked at 308 s reading within +-40 of 0, the 'Source clock off' alarm silent. This file pins the limit so that an estimator that one day reads the clock on such a delivery fails it on purpose; today's lucky fits were as blind (+7.6 here).
